item.title: Why there’s increase in terrorism, banditry – Peterside

item.title: Venezuela: Switzerland freezes all assets connected to Nicolás Maduro
item.description: The Swiss government has said that Switzerland has frozen all “Swiss-based assets connected to Nicolás Maduro.” In a statement, as quoted by the Guardian UK, Swiss officials said the Federal Council has decided to freeze assets held in Switzerland by Maduro and “other people connected to him” right away. item.title: Lagos APC begins electronic membership registration
item.description: Lagos State chapter of the All Progressives Congress, APC, has officially rolled out an electronic membership registration drive across all wards in the state. The party announced that the e-registration initiative, which commenced on Monday, will continue until the end of January, targeting both existing members and newcomers to create a comprehensive digital membership database. item.description: Ademola Lookman picked up the Man of the Match prize following the Super Eagles’ dominant victory over the Mambas of Mozambique, DAILY POST reports. Lookman was the star of the show as the Super Eagles thrashed their less-fancied opponent 4-0 in Fès on Monday night. item.title: Kano police decorates 13 promoted senior officers
item.description: The Kano State Police Command has decorated 13 senior officers who were recently promoted to higher ranks, The decoration took place during in a ceremony which held at the Police Officers mess in Kano. item.title: Kwankwaso reflects on political journey with Gov Yusuf
item.description: Former Kano State Governor and leader of the Kwankwasiyya movement, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, has celebrated the Executive Governor of Kano State, Alhaji Abba Kabir Yusuf, on the occasion of his birthday, offering prayers for wisdom and clarity in the year ahead.
